_readme: EDIT THIS FILE TO UPDATE EVENTS. One object per event. 'brand' must match a brand id in data/site.json (osc, decades, goodgroove, soulfood). 'date' is YYYY-MM-DD. The home page and each brand page automatically show that brand's next upcoming event. Event pages live at Event.dc.html?id=<id>. Use \n\n in text for a new paragraph. Optional per price tier: "status": "Sold out" or "On sale". Optional 'infoUrl': where the 'More info' button goes (external brand site or landing page). If blank, it uses the built-in Event page.
